# Fraud Analysis and Internal Control Review

This document details key action items for the Risk & Compliance department:

*   Review internal controls quarterly.
*   Review internal controls for strategy 2026.
*   Monitor legal risks urgently.
*   Update AML detection based on audit findings.
*   Monitor and update based on regulatory changes standard updates.
